source: RFP_Document_NSDF.pdf, Annexure III, pp. 34-35 (as extracted and approved)
note: Technical criteria scored from documents (65 marks). Eligibility and presentation are not in this file.

criteria.title: PMU assignments in sports
criteria.meaning: Completed PMU (project management unit) assignments of at least one year for a Central or State Government sports department, awarded at least 12 months before bid submission

criteria.title: Sports consulting projects >= Rs 1 crore
criteria.meaning: Completed sports consulting projects worth Rs 1 crore or more for central/state government sports departments or sports promotion organisations, marked by project value

criteria.title: Government consulting projects > Rs 5 crore
criteria.meaning: Completed consulting projects worth more than Rs 5 crore, each at least one year long, for any Central or State Government department

criteria.title: Project Manager CV
criteria.meaning: CV of the proposed Project Manager: MBA/PGDM or relevant master's with 10+ years in CSR, fundraising, project management, partnerships, marketing or sales, and prior sports or government experience

criteria.title: Senior Consultant (Sports) CVs
criteria.meaning: CVs of the three proposed Senior Consultants (Sports): MBA/PGDM, relevant master's or BTech with 7+ years in the same fields, and prior sports or government experience
